SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.conversation_uid AS conversationUid, c.agent_group_uid AS agentGroupUid, c.agent_uid AS agentUid, c.title AS title, COALESCE(latest_match.match_content, '') AS previewText, latest_match.match_created_time AS resultTime FROM agent_conversation c INNER JOIN ( SELECT m.conversation_uid, m.content AS match_content, m.created_time AS match_created_time, m.id AS match_id FROM agent_message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT conversation_uid, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM agent_message WHERE LOWER(content) LIKE #{keywordPattern} GROUP BY conversation_uid ) latest ON latest.conversation_uid = m.conversation_uid AND latest.max_id = m.id ) latest_match ON latest_match.conversation_uid = c.conversation_uid WHERE
c.agent_uid = #{agentUid} AND
latest_match.match_id IS NOT NULL
AND ( latest_match.match_created_time < #{beforeResultTime} OR ( latest_match.match_created_time = #{beforeResultTime} AND c.id < #{beforeConversationId} ) )
ORDER BY latest_match.match_created_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
